mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 540000 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 45% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95 (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) indicates a healthy economic expansion, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized (t-test p-value > 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in the core inflation rate above 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating price pressures, prompting central bank tightening expectations that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS > 100k monthly gain) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 0.2pp drop) signals a strong labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by boosting consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 0.2pp drop fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (over 3-year rolling windows).
